name: Rosa Hollis
role: Hollis bathhouse keeper; Keeper of the Vent Games' slate
voice: A bellow of a laugh; counts on her fingers; "and that's the long and short of it"; calls people love.
backstory: Rosa keeps the Hollis bathhouse on the lip of the Third Vent and, since 1480, the slate of the Vent Games, judging from an upturned tub with Old Marl's spoon. Half of Steamside brings its quarrels to her steps; Okton and Isine guess she'll be the Kharun commons elder.

relationships.name: Joss Marl
relationships.how: denies his Hollis claim every year
